Container.Name: VodMax
Container.Overview: Self-hosted media center for live TV, movies and series: M3U and Xtream Codes playlists you are entitled to use, EPG guide, pause and rewind, DVR recordings, movies and series from your folders, profiles. Apps for Android, Android TV, Fire TV and LG webOS. Can also act as an HDHomeRun tuner and M3U/XMLTV source for Plex, Jellyfin and Emby. VodMax provides no content. First login: the admin token is in appdata/vodmax/admin.token.
Container.Description: Self-hosted media center for live TV, movies and series. VodMax provides no content.

Config.Name: Media (read only)
Config.Description: Your movie and series folders, for the collections (optional)

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns the data (Unraid: 99, nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that owns the data (Unraid: 100, users)

Config.Name: Graphics card (Intel/AMD)
Config.Description: Optional: /dev/dri, for video conversion with the graphics card (Settings, System)

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone, for the guide and the recordings
